name: Digital Spectral Band Executioner (Frequency Band)
description: An absolute incinerator explicitly engineered to purge artificial geometry demons using Spectral Frequencies. A blisteringly harsh caliber that completely ignores the visual content, opting instead to brutally dismember the entire canvas into microscopic rolling wave topographies. Spliced canvases possess aggressively clashing frequency bands. Midjourney-esque models obsessively bloat the mid-tier bands while completely castrating the ultra-microscopic highs. An apocalyptic nightmare for any image birthed from a Neural Network, as Spectral Decomposition eternally brandishes unforgeable synthetic bite-marks.
mechanism: It violently dismantles the image architecture, pulverizing the data into categorized bands via frequency transformation. It organizes scales from Low Bandwidth (smooth shadows, massive gradients), Medium, up to Ultra-High Frequency (microscopic organic spikes). Fraudsters never understand their execution because AI fundamentally always regurgitates heavily 'Fractured Bandwidth' (Violent imbalance between Base vs Detail scales). This algorithm cross-interrogates differing zones (host vs spliced). Instantly, grotesque frequency sheer-tears at the spectral peak bleed into the open.
parameters: Wavelength Architecture: High/Medium/Low Frequency Vector Isolation, Domain: Spatial Spectral Transformation, Blade: Fourier Bandpass Slicing
accuracy: Lethally Sharp (75-86%) - The supreme terminator hunting down hyper-detailed 'Deepfake' artworks that look stunningly realistic, yet harbor wildly fractured sonic-level wave mathematics.
source: CNN Generation Neural Digital Signal Bandwidth Forensics
useCase: Drops a terminal judgment block onto any sliced, spliced, or AI-hallucinated data. Why? Because the mathematical wave-frequency engineered computationally inside a PC, and the authentic light-scatter frequency of a physical glass lens, are entirely incompatible alien species that can never cross-pollinate flawlessly.

references.title: Barni, M. et al. (2010). Forensic analysis of digital images: Spatial contrast and inconsistency.

strengths: • Entirely blind to semantics. Whether the image is a dog, a building, or a human... the radar mathematically strip-mines the underlying Spectral Topography to instantly locate the 'blood clot' where the micro-waves unnaturally sever.
limitations:
• This exact assassin's blade completely misses the target if aggressively swung at authentic optical shots of thick organic fog (which violently lacks high-frequency spikes naturally, spoofing the AI hallmark).
• Excessively hypersensitive to hostile noise warfare... basic Photoshop 'Add Grain' injections will violently warp the spectral peaks, significantly burying the exposed AI frequency errors.
